[Verse 1]
[C]After all the jacks are [Bb]in their box-
[F]es And the
[C]clowns have all [Bb]gone to
[F]bed You can
[C]hear happiness [Bb]staggering on
[F]down the street
[G]Footprints [Bb]dressed in re-
[Eb/Bb]d [E/B][F/C]And the
[G]wind [Bb]whispers
[E/B][Eb/Bb]Mary [F/C]
[Eb/G]  [E/G#]  [F/A]

[Verse 2]
[C]A broom is [Bb]drearily sweepin-
[F]g Up the
[C]broken pieces of [Bb]yesterdays life
[F]
[C]Somewhere a [Bb]queen is
[F]weeping Some-
[G]where a king [Bb]has no
[Eb/Bb]wife [E/B][F/C]And the
[G]wind it [Bb]cries
[E/B][Eb/Bb]Mary [F/C]
[Eb/G]  [E/G#]  [F/A]

[Solo]
[F/A]  [Eb/G]
[Bb]  [Ab]
[F]  [Eb/G]
[Bb]  [Ab]
[F]  [Eb/G]
[Bb]  [Ab]
[G]
[Bb]
[Db]
[F]

[Verse 3]
[C]The traffic lights, they turn [Bb]blue to-
[F]morrow And
[C]shine their emptiness [Bb]down on my
[F]bed The tiny
[C]island [Bb]sags down
[F]stream Cause the
[G]life they lived is [Bb]is de-
[Eb/Bb]ad [E/B][F/C]And the
[G]wind [Bb]screams
[Eb/Bb]Mary [E/B][F/C]
[Eb/G]  [E/G#]  [F/A]

[Verse 4]
[C]Will the wind [Bb]ever re-
[F]member The names
[C]it has [Bb]blow in the past
[F]And with this
[C]crutch it's old [Bb]age and it's
[F]wisdom It whispers no
[G]this will [Bb]be the la-
[Eb/Bb]st [E/B][F/C]And the
[G]wind [Bb]cries
[E/B][Eb/Bb]Mary [F/C]
[Eb/G]  [E/G#]  [F/A]

title: The Wind Cries Mary
